✨PMSoc Annual General Meeting 2026✨

AGM is officially complete, and the baton has been passed !!

To our 2025-2026 Executive Committee - thank you for your dedication, hard work and everything you’ve poured into PMSoc this past year. Your contributions have shaped our society, and we’re grateful for the legacy you leave behind💙

To our 2026-2027 Executive Committee - welcome aboard !! We’re excited to see your vision and leadership take PMSoc into its next chapter🌟

Thank you for an incredible year, and here’s to everything ahead !!

An insightful evening at the PMLogic August Mixer, where members of PMSoc joined industry professionals to unpack the challenges of project complexity.

Thank you to the PMLogic team and panel for inviting us and sharing your perspectives on navigating uncertainty and competing priorities.

Looking forward to attending more events by the team!!
